{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–4 (Players Committee PDF slips). It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 4]] and not a GEMP environment.}}
'''Premiere - Original VS4''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] and [[Reflections III]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–4. [[Virtual Set 4 (Original)|Virtual Set 4]] (Battle Of Hoth): Legal 5 February 2003.<ref name="vs4">[[Virtual Set 4 (Original)]]</ref> The short name '''POVS4''' is used in GEMP importable deck file names.

Wiki decklists use this format when the newest original-era virtual card in the list comes from Virtual Set 4.
